rules.retrieved_snippet: Council of Europe Octopus page (search summary): the 2018 law replaced the Computer Crime Act of 2007 and addresses illegal access, data interference and illegal interception; ARTICLE 19 reports Article 23 criminalizes violation of privacy and that 2020 amendments added penalties for online 'fake news'; official text reportedly not published; a 2025 amendment is unverified.
